sentences.text: In short: TSHAN FRISØR AS is an established small company in "frisering og barbering" based in Oslo, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
TSHAN FRISØR AS is registered in the industry "Frisering og barbering"; its registered activity is "Hårklipp og hårpleie.".
TSHAN FRISØR AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2018-03-12, registered in Oslo.
It has 12 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 3.37M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 255,695 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 7.6% and a moderate equity ratio of 40% of total assets.

Revenue rose 29.9% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 2.59M to NOK 3.37M); it was NOK 2.61M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 101,432, 2024: NOK 55,019, 2025: NOK 187,299).
TSHAN FRISØR AS is led by board chair Hafzullah Adam Tovi.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2024-02-05.
TSHAN FRISØR AS has 1 registered workplace.
